items.en: Ukraine's Navy says it hit six Su-34M bombers at Borisoglebsk air base in Voronezh Oblast with Neptune missiles; Zelensky claims four destroyed
items.nl: Oekraïense marine zegt met Neptune-raketten zes Su-34M-bommenwerpers op vliegbasis Borisoglebsk (oblast Voronezj) te hebben geraakt; Zelensky claimt er vier vernietigd
items.sEn: On the night of 14-15 October 2026 the Ukrainian Navy struck the Borisoglebsk military airfield in Russia's Voronezh Oblast, roughly 400 km from the front line, with its Neptune coastal missile system. items.en: Third Yak-130M prototype flies as Russia turns its jet trainer into a radar-equipped light combat aircraft

items.sEn: The third prototype of the Yak-130M, an upgraded version of the Yak-130 jet trainer reworked to carry radar and guided weapons, has made its first flight from the Irkutsk Aviation Plant, according to Russia's United Aircraft Corporation (UAC). items.en: russia Purchased T-34-85 Tanks in Exchange for T-72s and Yak-130s From Laos, Whose Pilots Will Now Be Trained by China

items.sEn: Defense Express recalls that Russia acquired T-34-85 tanks from Laos in exchange for T-72s and Yak-130s; the T-34s have appeared in Moscow military parades since 2019.
